overview.description: The Grayscale Bitcoin Miners ETF (GCPU) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Indxx Bitcoin Miners index. MNRS tracks an index of global companies that generate revenue from bitcoin mining activities or mining related services. Constituents are selected and weighted based on market-cap and revenue tied to the relevant theme. GCPU was launched on Jan 30, 2025 and is issued by Grayscale.
